source: A FNAF movie 2 rp thats realistic and has the full FNAF movie 2 map with all the characters on a menu and some gamepasses

answers.ask: Should the map be the pizzeria interior only, or include the exterior lot and street around it?
answers.answer: Include the full pizzeria interior plus a small exterior lot and street around it for a complete realistic movie map.

answers.ask: Is the character menu a GUI morph picker, or an in-world room where the animatronics stand on display?
answers.answer: Use a GUI morph picker menu with all characters available to select.
